_comment: Get Folder Path measured on FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 (macOS, 2026-10-19): every case was pasted into one script, FileMaker's displayed line read, and the script copied back (xml, FileMaker's own bytes). The cases cover Repetition empty, 1, 2 and $i, each with Dialog title and Default location empty or set, plus Allow Folder Creation off, no variable, a global, quoted text holding ; and ], and a calculated subscript.

FileMaker draws the variable first with the repetition as its subscript (none for 1 or empty), then Dialog title and Default location unlabeled, leaving an empty one out. FileMaker writes no element for an empty calculation.

kind: exact = the line says everything the step stores; guess = only one of Dialog title and Default location is set, and FileMaker draws the same line for either (read as Dialog title); noVariable = no Name, so the first calculation is drawn where the variable goes.

cases.fmLine: Get Folder Path [ Allow Folder Creation ; $result ]
